rules.title: Deterministic workflow code
rules.text: Keep workflow code deterministic: no random values, wall-clock time, network calls or unordered iteration inside workflows.

rules.title: Side effects in activities
rules.text: Put all I/O and side effects in activities and keep workflows as orchestration only.

rules.title: Idempotent activities
rules.text: Make activities idempotent because they can be retried or run more than once.

rules.title: Explicit timeouts and retries
rules.text: Set start-to-close timeouts and a retry policy on every activity.

rules.title: Small payloads
rules.text: Pass identifiers rather than large payloads through workflow inputs and history.

rules.title: Version workflow changes
rules.text: Change running workflows only through versioning or patching so replays of existing executions stay valid.
